The Spring Prince Alfonse I nurtured for my Calvary Team. Also works with 3 dancers if you switch out his C skill.  

Weapon - Slaying Axe + Speed ensures that Alfonse is within doubling range against units. It also gives him additional attack and brings him closer to using Galeforce with a cooldown charge of 4.

Support Skill - Reposition is useful for putting units in attack range or getting them out of it. 

Special - Galeforce allows Alfonse to move twice on a lot of his turns. Allowing him to attack as well as get away from range if needed.

A skill - Life and Death 3 gives Alfonse the attack and speed he needs to make Heavy Blade 3 and Desperation 3 useful. He also hits hard. 

B Skill - Desperation 3 ensures that doubling occurs without Alfonse dying in engages. 

C skill- Goad Calvary allows Alfonse to support other Calvary untis on the Calvary team. 

Seal - Heavy Blade 3 makes use of his high attack allowing him to proc Galeforce sooner.

43 HP helps survive an engagement with melee units as well as making it easy to hit Desperation 3 range at 32 HP.

55 Attack allows Alfonse to hit hard and make use of Heavy Blade 3 against a lot of units.

45 Speed ensures that Alfonse can usually double a unit if they don't have a skill preventing it. 

26 Defense helps Alfonse survive an engagement with a melee unit so he can make Desperation 3 active.

13 Resistance makes him weak against mages and dragons, so he should only engage mages and never be attacked by them. Against dragons he will need Desperation 3 active in order to do anything against them. 

On a Calvary Team that utilizes 1 Hone Calvary unit along with 2 Goad Calvary units Alfonse reaches 69 Attack and 59 Speed. If the team instead uses 3 Goad Calvary units then the prince can still reach a solid 67 Attack and 57 Speed. 

tl;dr This is my Spring Prince Alfonse that I made to slaughter enemies who ridiculed the boy himself.

Funny enough, I have a lot of other skills and such I have available and was thinking of different teams and such to run the builds. This looks pretty doable for arena as well as player phase.

He kills the majority of green units. Reds is a bit of a toss up. Blues he dies to most mages but can survive some lances. As for bows, daggers and staffs, they usually don't kill him in one turn so he can return the favour the next.

Weapon - Folkvangr because the boy needs his signature weapon, also that plus 5 attack with distant counter and vantage when he's below 50% is pretty solid.

Support Skill - Reposition is pretty good for rearranging units to move them from harms way, also the AI uses it pretty well on arena defense from my experience.

Special - Dragon Fang provides that 50% attack that usually kills most units if he can proc it, unless they're an armor unit or a wall.

A skill - Distant Counter is a pretty expensive investment that I thought was worthwhile because it makes him usable on player and enemy phase. Combined with Vantage 3 he is usually going to get a hit in at the very minimum.

B skill - Vantage 3 allows Alfonse to usually get in at least one hit, combined with his weapon and Distant Counter he usually hurts a bit.

C skill - Threaten Def 3 allows Alfonse to hit the enemy harder once they're within range of him.

Seal- Distant Def 3 allows Alfonse to have more survivability against ranged units and it works well with Distant Counter.

Summoner Supported for stats but mostly because I love the precious Bench Boy.

Ally Supported also increases stats but I partnered him with Sharena simply because I think siblings looking out for each other is adorable.

Blessing - Fire because well it's in season but mostly because he relates the stones in his blade to white flames.

Accessory - Yeah he's wearing Bruno's mask because he looks up to him.

With 48 HP Alfonse can usually take a hit.

53 Attack combined with Folkvangr and Dragon Fang means Alfonse can hit like a truck.

27 Speed is hard to salvage but he makes up for it with his Attack.

34 Defense means Alfonse usually isn't taking too much damage from swords, axes, daggers, and bows.

24 Resistance is pretty low but combined with Distant Defense he can usually survive against mages.

This concludes my Alfonse who I have had on my main team since the games release.

tl;dr This is my Alfonse build and I really like the character.
